contents.configuration.markdown.copyFiles.destina:
Mengonfigurasi the path dan berkas name of berkas dibuat oleh salin/tempel atau drag dan drop. This is a map of globs that match against a Markdown document path to the destination path where the new berkas should be dibuat.

The destination path may use the following variables:

- `${documentDirName}` — Absolute parent direktori path of the Markdown document, e.g. `/Users/me/myProject/docs`.
- `${documentRelativeDirName}` — Relative parent direktori path of the Markdown document, e.g. `docs`. This is the same as `${documentDirName}` if the berkas is not part of a ruang kerja.
- `${documentFileName}` — The full filename of the Markdown document, e.g. `README.md`.
- `${documentBaseName}` — The basename of the Markdown document, e.g. `README`.
- `${documentExtName}` — The ekstensi of the Markdown document, e.g. `md`.
- `${documentFilePath}` — Absolute path of the Markdown document, e.g. `/Users/me/myProject/docs/README.md`.
- `${documentRelativeFilePath}` — Relative path of the Markdown document, e.g. `docs/README.md`. This is the same as `${documentFilePath}` if the berkas is not part of a ruang kerja.
- `${documentWorkspaceFolder}` — The ruang kerja folder untuk the Markdown document, e.g. `/Users/me/myProject`. This is the same as `${documentDirName}` if the berkas is not part of a ruang kerja.
- `${fileName}` — The berkas name of the dropped berkas, e.g. `image.png`.
- `${fileExtName}` — The ekstensi of the dropped berkas, e.g. `png`.
- `${unixTime}` — The saat ini Unix timestamp in milliseconds.
- `${isoTime}` — The saat ini time in ISO 8601 format, e.g. '2025-06-06T08:40:32.123Z'.
contents.configuration.markdown.copyFiles.overwri: Mengontrol jika berkas dibuat oleh drop atau tempel should overwrite existing berkas.

If a berkas dengan the same name already exists, overwrite it.
contents.configuration.markdown.preferredMdPathEx: Mengontrol jika berkas ekstensi (untuk example `.md`) are added atau not untuk links to Markdown berkas. This pengaturan is used when berkas paths are added oleh tooling such as path completions atau berkas renames.
untuk existing paths, try to maintain the berkas ekstensi style. untuk new paths, add berkas ekstensi.
Prefer including the berkas ekstensi. untuk example, path completions to a berkas named `file.md` will insert `file.md`.
Prefer menghapus the berkas ekstensi. untuk example, path completions to a berkas named `file.md` will insert `file` tanpa the `.md`.
Snippet used when adding videos to Markdown. This snippet can use the following variables:
- `${src}` — The resolved path of the video berkas.
- `${title}` — The title used untuk the video. A snippet placeholder will automatically be dibuat untuk this variable.

Snippet used when adding audio to Markdown. This snippet can use the following variables:
- `${src}` — The resolved path of the audio  berkas.
- `${title}` — The title used untuk the audio. A snippet placeholder will automatically be dibuat untuk this variable.
contents.configuration.markdown.editor.updateLink:
Aktifkan/nonaktifkan a tempel option that updates links dan reference in text that is disalin dan ditempelkan between Markdown editor.

To use this feature, after menempelkan text that contains updatable links, just click on the tempel Widget dan pilih `Paste and update pasted links`.
